style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 2ft 11 Pre Lit Potted Grandis Fir Outdoor Plug in Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Seize the celebration with the 90cm Pre Lit Potted Grandis Fir Outdoor Plug in Christmas Tree. Standing at 90cm tall, it goes great in gardens and front lawns alongside potted plants; the artificial foliage handles both the sun and rain with ease. Use the ‘on’ mode for a constant ever-glow, or the optional 6-hour timer turns the lights on automatically every evening and then off again to save you the work, so you can focus on family and friends. The lights are low maintenance; their inspirational shine picks you up through the winter. Put it in your front lawn or garden to sparkle and excite friends, family, and passersby. The discreet cable and black pot blend into the evening to make the sparkling light stand out. The pre lit potted tree is a marvellous addition to any outdoor space. Inspire friends and family and keep the night aglow. Have an uplifting winter with the mighty Grandis Fir. Make your garden a magic wonderland year after year – so long as you treat it with care.
